fusions.name: Second Helping
fusions.desc: Bashes the target and takes a bite of what breaks off: it deals 7 damage, leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds, and you heal for 30% of the damage dealt. It holds 4 charges, and a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Board Is Laid
fusions.desc: Slams the shield down flat as a table between your allies, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. You regain 10 health, and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Rations Behind the Line
fusions.desc: Passes food back from behind the shield: restores 14 health to you and every ally within 4 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

fusions.name: Fat of the Table
fusions.desc: When you are healed, you gain a shield worth 10% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
